title: Biryani Style Butter Chicken Meatballs & Cucumber Riata

ingredientSections.heading: Meatballs
items: 900g Ground Chicken Thigh with skin (ask your butcher)
1 tsp each of Cardamom, Garam Masala, Cumin, Black Pepper

ingredientSections.heading: Butter Chicken Sauce
items: 1 Tbsp each of Turmeric, Coriander Seed, Cardamom and Black Pepper

methodSections.heading: Preparing the Meatballs
steps: In a large mixing bowl combine chicken with ground spices, salt and pepper and mix well.
Add the remaining ingredients and combine until the it holds together.
Roll the mix into small ping-pong sized balls and place on a large baking tray with a little space between each.
Pre-cook in the oven for 20 minutes. Cooking will finish in the sauce.

methodSections.heading: Butter Chicken Sauce
steps: Melt butter over a low heat in a large heavy base Dutch oven or oven proof pot. Add the chopped onions and stir constantly until the onions are translucent. Staying on a low heat, add garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.

Add spices, salt and pepper and tandoori paste (and chillies, optional) and increase to a medium heat. Stir constantly and cook for 5 minutes, scraping the bottom of the pan to avoid burning. Add one cup of the stock to deglaze the pan.
Add chopped tomatoes and tomato paste. Mix well and cook for one minute. Add the rest of the stock, mix well and bring to a boil stirring constantly.
Reduce the temperature to low and add the cashews and cream. Stir to combine and simmer for five minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool for five minutes.
Carefully blend the sauce using a hand-held immersion blender until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Place the partially cooked meatballs into the sauce and mix gently so that the meatballs are fully immersed and coated.
Place the pot in the oven, cover with a tight fitting lid and cook for one and a half hours, checking and stirring gently after one hour.
Serve with rice and riata and garnish with fresh cilantro.

methodSections.heading: Cucumber Riata
steps: Skin and deseed the cucumber and then chop finely.
